title: String search methods
starterCode:
const sentence = "JavaScript is awesome and JavaScript is fun"
return {
  indexOfFirst: sentence.indexOf("JavaScript"),
  lastIndexOf: sentence.lastIndexOf("JavaScript"),
  includes: sentence.includes("awesome"),
  startsWith: sentence.startsWith("JavaScript"),
  endsWith: sentence.endsWith("fun")
}
